name: roadmaps-foundation
description: Development tooling and generated API documentation

scripts.build: npm --prefix API run build && npm --prefix ANGULAR run build
scripts.lint: npm --prefix API run lint && npm --prefix ANGULAR run lint
scripts.test: npm --prefix API test && npm --prefix API run test:e2e && npm --prefix ANGULAR test -- --watch=false
scripts.docs:generate: npm --prefix API run docs:openapi && node scripts/generate-postman.mjs
